main_text.head: [illegible, ~12 letters]
main_text.p: Canon primus. Quod Canones Apostolici, & priscorum Patrum in Synodis tam Occidentalibus, quam Orientalibus definiti, tanquam pupilla oculi custodiantur; nec ulli fas sit transgredi ullum eorum; & ut omnes pij Patres, & Rectores Ecclesiarum sedulo, & diligenter eos meditentur, ac in eorum se exerceant lectione, & custodiant illos. Ex his vide, doctissime Leo, quae sit Hottingeri in rebus Orientalibus eruditio, nisi id adscribatur malitiae, & fraudi, quae ipsi proprietas est inseparabilis. Sed ad reliqua.

Post haec plura aggerit Hottingerus tumultuarie, ac sine numerorum notis ad ostendendam varietatem Romanos inter, & Orientales, & primo: Sed & plures, inquit, ad euincendam varietatem, diversos dies festos, Ieiunia utrique habent, multum ipsis testibus, & Pontificiis, & Græcis distantia. Quasi vero dierum festorum, ac Ieiuniorum varietas ipsi officit Religioni, & variam efficit. Quod nemo profecto sanæ mentis dicet, nisi insanire, & Hottingerum agere velit. Etenim in ipsa Romana Ecclesia quidam alicubi celebrantur dies festi, qui alibi, vel minime, vel alio tempore, quemadmodum, & quædam Ieiunia.

page.notes: The Hebrew line at the head could not be read and is marked illegible. The Greek and Hebrew in the text were checked against the scan. Long s is plain s throughout. Printed spelling was kept, including "Pontificijs" (normalised to "Pontificiis"), "Gracis", and "euincendam". The printed forms "fanæ" and "infanire" were read as "sanæ" and "insanire" from the long-s pattern. The page has no margin notes, and the light stains and show-through were left out.
